sources.role: FM TOWNS ROM/CMOS paths, command-line input, save-state and media behaviour

paths.path: Tsugaru executable directory and command-line options; GUI settings are stored by the desktop frontend
paths.naming: Command-line option syntax is -OPTION value (for example -CMOS <file> and -CD <image>); no portable cross-platform settings filename is specified by command.md

Input is selected by Tsugaru's keyboard/gamepad options and GUI bindings; the command documentation names device/key tokens such as ANA0..ANA3 for analog directions but publishes no standalone binding file

paths.path: FM TOWNS ROM directory supplied to Tsugaru (the ROM directory contains the machine ROM assets); CMOS settings image is supplied separately with -CMOS
paths.naming: Required ROM assets retain the filenames expected by the selected FM TOWNS model; CMOS.BIN is the conventional settings-image filename. The cited source publishes no canonical ROM checksum

paths.path: Writes occur in the emulated FM TOWNS disks/media; CMOS.BIN stores BIOS settings
paths.naming: Game data uses the filesystem inside mounted disk images; CMOS settings use CMOS.BIN, with no universal per-game sidecar save name

paths.path: State path selected by Tsugaru save-state command/UI
paths.naming: Quick state files use the Tsugaru state-file format with .TState naming when supplied via -LOADSTATE/-SAVESTATE; exact default directory is user-selected
-OPTION value command-line grammar; no separate stable settings filename is specified
Keyboard/gamepad options with ANA0..ANA3 analog tokens; no standalone binding file is published

paths.path: FM TOWNS ROM directory plus -CMOS CMOS.BIN
paths.naming: Model-specific ROM filenames as expected by the loader; conventional CMOS.BIN; no canonical checksum is published

paths.path: Mounted FM TOWNS disk images and CMOS.BIN
paths.naming: Filesystem/media-defined saves; CMOS.BIN for settings, no universal per-game sidecar
-SAVESTATE/-LOADSTATE state files use the documented .TState format

paths.path: Tsugaru executable/app directory and command-line/UI options
paths.naming: -OPTION value command-line grammar; no separate stable settings filename is specified
Keyboard/gamepad options with ANA0..ANA3 analog tokens; no standalone binding file is published

paths.naming: Model-specific ROM filenames; conventional CMOS.BIN; no canonical checksum is published
